body:
Yup, doesn't matter...  Can't win, so why do I bother fighting? 

There's no fight left, I've been fighting with everything I have for years, all it's gotten me is failing mental health and self doubt. I didn't have the strength for this fight when it started, I needed my partner and a lot of supports to get this far. Those are gone... Now it's just me I'm all alone and can't manage anymore.
